question: Should the experimental Claws package contract adopt `CLAW.md` as the canonical exported artifact once the prerequisite lifecycle stack lands, while continuing to accept grouped JSON input?
rationale: This changes the user-authored and exported package format; code review can assess implementation safety, but maintainers must choose the enduring experimental product contract and landing order.

options.title: Adopt the canonical Markdown format
options.body: After the lifecycle stack lands, retain this adapter and require focused fresh-install and legacy-JSON round-trip proof before merging.

options.title: Keep JSON canonical for now
options.body: Defer the export-format switch and preserve the existing JSON artifact until the Claws lifecycle and distribution direction are settled.

recommendation.title: Adopt the canonical Markdown format
recommendation.body: After the lifecycle stack lands, retain this adapter and require focused fresh-install and legacy-JSON round-trip proof before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor has carried both the prior merged stack implementation and the active restacked format proposal.
